Hi team,

Quick procurement assessment:
- Vendor classification: Keystone is a US channel partner (standard supplier).
- Minimum required evidence for invoice-only pilot: W-9 (we have), COI (vendor can provide), vendor bank remit + ACH or check remittance, and a completed Vendor Onboarding Form (I will attach our short form).
- Risk threshold: procurement can approve temporary invoice-only for pilots up to USD 10,000 without exec escalation if vendor is registered and COI is provided. Above that we escalate to Finance Ops.
- Duration: recommend a single temporary window (max 45 days) tied to specific invoice numbers.
- Controls: require a written email acknowledgment from the vendor that Redwood will not be liable for extended commitments beyond the pilot, and include net-30 payment terms on Redwood side. We will also flag the vendor record as "Invoice-only pilot" for auditing.

If Sales is comfortable with the $8.4k estimate, Procurement can approve this with the items above. I will draft the Vendor Onboarding Form and include the evidence checklist (COI, W-9, remit).

Naomi Feldman
